title: Crazy Foot
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 1 "circle left 3 places on left diagonal" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 4 "pass through to an ocean wave - robins by left in the center, partners by right on the sides" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins cannot join left hands facing the way they do.
Row 5 "partners allemande right ¾ to long wave on the side of set" can't start from where the dancers are: This allemande does not end facing across, in long waves.
Row 6 "balance & box circulate - robins cross while larks loop right · box circulate" can't start from where the dancers are: Looping right would go the wrong way along the line here.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
